sa: रूपं सुदर्शनस्यासीदाकाशे पततस्तदा। द्वितीयस्येव सूर्यस्य युगान्ते प्रपतिष्यतः॥
en: Rising into the sky, the Sudarshana (discuss) seemed to look like the exceedingly effulgent sun at the end of the Yuga.

sa: बहुयोजनविस्तीर्णो बहुयोजनमायतः। तत्र रौद्रो दानवेन्द्रो महावीर्यपराक्रमः॥ मधुकैटभयोः पुत्रो धुन्धुर्नाम सुदारुणः। अन्तर्भूमिगतो राजन् वसत्यमितविक्रमः॥
en: It extends many yojanas in length and breadth. There lives a fearful and greatly powerful Danava chief. He is the fearful son of Madhukaitabha and his name is Dhundhu. O king, this immeasurably powerful one lives underneath the ground.

sa: त्वमेव राजशार्दूल सम्राडो महाक्रतुम्। सम्प्राप्नुहि त्वया प्राप्ते कृतकृत्यास्ततो वयम्॥ यजस्वाभीप्सितं यज्ञं मयि श्रेयस्यवस्थिते। नियुक्ष्व त्वं च मां कृत्ये सर्वं कर्तास्मि ते वचः॥
en: Krishna said O best of kings, you deserve the imperial dignity. Let therefore the great (Rajasuya) sacrifice be performed. If you perform that sacrifice, and if you obtain its fruit, we shall all consider ourselves as crowned with success. I am always engaged in seeking your good. Perform the sacrifice you desire. Appoint me in some office in that sacrifice. I shall obey all your commands.

sa: आत्मानं च परांश्चैव त्रायते महतो भयात्। क्रुध्यन्तमप्रतिक्रुध्यन् द्वयोरेष चिकित्सकः॥
en: One, that does not act against a person whose anger has been excited, saves himself and others from great fear-in fact he is the physician of both.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा दिवमाक्रम्य क्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत। ब्राह्मीं श्रियं सुविपुलां बिभ्रद् देवर्षिसत्तमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, that foremost of all celestial Rishis, adorned with surprising Vedic grace, disappeared from the scene, passing into the sky.

sa: ददर्श तत्र कौन्तेयंधर्मराजमरिदमम्। तापसै भ्रातभिश्चैव सर्वतः परिवारितम्॥
en: He saw there the son of Kunti, that chastiser of foes, Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) surrounded by the ascetics and by his brothers.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्ते वामदेवेन राजन् समुत्तस्थू राक्षसा घोररूपाः। तैः शूलहस्तैर्वध्यमानः स राजा प्रोवाचेदं वाक्यमुच्चैस्तदानीम्॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, when the king had been thus addressed by Vamadeva, there rose four fearful-featured Rakshasas. As they with up lifted lances in their hands came to the king with the intention of killing him, he thus cried aloud,

sa: उष्य द्वादशरात्रं तु नियतो नियताशन:। प्रदक्षिणमुपावृत्य जम्बूमार्गं समाविशेत्॥
en: Having lived for twelve nights at Pushkara with regulated diet and regulated food and having walked round it, one goes to Jambu marga. at

sa: मृगया चोचिता राजन्नस्मिन् काले सुतस्य ते। दुर्योधनस्य गमनं समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: O king, this is also an excellent season for your son Duryodhana to go to a hunting expedition. Therefore you should grant him permission to go there.

sa: भूपाश्च नाभागभगीरथादयो महीमिमां सागरान्तां विजित्य। सत्येन तेऽप्यजयंस्तात लोकान् नेशे बलस्येति चरेदधर्मम्॥
en: Having conquered by truth this earth bounded by seas the kings headed by Nabhaga and Bhagiratha obtained, O my son, all the regions hereafter. Therefore, none should act unrighteously thinking "I am powerful."

sa: करेणुयूथैः सह यूथपानां मदोत्कटानामचलप्रभाणाम्। महान्ति यूथानि महाद्विपानां तस्मिन् वने राष्ट्रपतिर्ददर्श॥
en: In that forest the king (also) saw the leaders of elephant-herds, gigantic like hills with temporal juice trickling down in the season of rut and accompanied by herds of she-elephants.

sa: रैभ्यो विद्वान् सहापत्यस्तपस्वी चेतरोऽभवत्। तयोश्चाप्यतुला कीर्तिर्बाल्यात् प्रभृति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Raivya and his sons became learned and the other (Bharadvaja) became an ascetic. From their childhood their friendship was matchless.

sa: ततो विनशनं गच्छेत् सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति सोमलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then one should go to Vinashana which destroys all sins. He obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Soma.

sa: प्रच्छाद्यमानं रक्षोभिः पाण्डवं प्रियदर्शनम्। ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि सूर्यमभ्रगणैरिव॥
en: All the creatures, then, saw the good-looking Pandava hemmed in by the Rakshasas and appearing like the sun enveloped with clouds.

sa: ऋतुपर्णश्च राजेन्द्रो बाहुकस्य हयज्ञताम्। चिन्तयन् मुमुदे राजा सहवार्ष्णेयसारथिः॥
en: Along with his charioteer, Varshneya, the excellent king Rituparna, highly delighted, was absorbed in the thought, regarding Bahuka's knowledge in the management of horses.

sa: ततो विशल्यामासाद्य नदीं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताम्। अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the river Vishalya, celebrated over the three worlds, one obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice and goes to the celestials region.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं त्वत्तः सर्वमशेषतः। तत्त्वेन हि ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छन्त्या देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: I desire to hear from you all about her in detail. Do you surely relate to me, as I am asking of that lady of celestials splendour.”

sa: ततो गोपाः प्रगातारः कुशला नृत्यवादने। धार्तराष्ट्रमुपातिष्ठन् कन्याश्चैव स्वलंकृताः॥
en: The herdsman, well-skilled in singing and dancing and playing on musical instruments and maidens adorned with ornaments ministered to the pleasures of Dhritarashtra's son.

sa: विद्युदूपां महाघोरामाकाशे महतीं गदाम्। शरैबर्हभिरभ्या द् भीमसेनः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Bhimasena too, on his part, beset, with many arrows, sharpened on stones, that tremendous and dreadful mace in the sky resembling a lightning flash.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो महेष्वासः शक्त्यामितपराक्रमः। गदां जचाह कौन्तेयः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: (Thus) severely wounded, that great bowman, the exceedingly powerful son of Kunti, with eyes rolling in wrath, took up his mace.

sa: दुर्योधनो गुरुद्वेषी त्यक्ताचारसुहृज्जनः। अर्थलुब्धोऽभिमानी च नीचः प्रकृतिनिघृणः॥
en: Duryodhana is malicious towards his superiors; he has abandoned all good conduct; he is covetous, vain, mean and by nature cruel.

sa: नष्टात्मा कलिना स्पृष्टस्तत् तद् विगणयन् नृपः। जगामैकां वने शून्ये भार्यामुत्सृज्य दुःखितः॥
en: Losing his senses through the influence of Kali and ruminating over a variety of thoughts, the king went away with his heart full of sorrow, forsaking his wife, alone, in that solitary wilderness.

sa: शोणस्य नर्मदायाश्च प्रभवे कुरुनन्दन। वंशगुल्म उपस्पृश्य वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, bathing in Vanshagulma which is the source of the Shona and the Narmada one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनः प्रेष्यानादिदेश सहस्रशः। आक्रीडावसथा: क्षिप्नं क्रियन्तामिति भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Duryodhana, having arrived at that place, commanded thousands of his men to build there pleasure houses with the least delay.

sa: लोमश उवाच यदा त्वमन्यतागस्त्यो गार्हस्थ्ये तां क्षमामिति। तदाभिगम्य प्रोवाच वैदर्भ पृथिवीपतिम्॥
en: Lomasha said : When Agastya thought that she had become fit for leading a domestic life, he went to the ruler of the earth, the king of Vidarbha and spoke to him thus.

sa: गणैरप्सरसां चैव त्रिदशानां तथाऽऽत्मजैः। विहारशीलः क्रीडार्थं तेन तत् संवृतं सरः॥
en: He had come surrounded by various Apsaras and also by many sons of the celestials. Having come to that lake to sport, he had closed the place to all comers.

sa: सूक्ष्मप्रावारानजिनोत्तरीयान् दृष्टवारण्ये निर्धनानप्रतिष्ठान्। कां त्वं प्रीति लप्स्यसे याज्ञसेनि पतिं वृणीष्वेह यमन्यमिच्छसि॥
en: O Yajnaseni, what joy will you get in seeing these your husbands in the forest attired in skins and rags and deprived of their wealth and possessions. Select a husband from these present.

sa: कृष्णस्तु पार्थेन समेत्य विद्वान् धनंजयेनासुरतर्जनेन। बभौ यथा भूतपतिर्महात्मा समेत्य साक्षाद् भगवान् गुहेन॥
en: And the learned Krishna being joined with the Partha, Dhananjaya (winner of riches), the slayer of demons looked as, beautiful as that high-souled divine lord of all created beings (Shiva) when united with Kartikeya (his son).

sa: समारुह्य नरश्रेष्ठ स्तनकुण्डेषु संविशेत्। स्तनकुण्डमुपस्पृश्य वाजपेयफलं लभेत्॥
en: O foremost of men, ascending it one should go to Stanakunda Bathing in Stanakunda, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice).

sa: तमृते भीमधन्वानं भीमादवरजं वने। कामये काम्यके वासं नेदानीममरोपमम्॥
en: Without that great bowman, the younger brother of Bhima, without that celestials-like hero, I do not any longer desire to dwell in this Kamyaka.

sa: यस्यामाख्यायते पुण्या दिशि गोदावरी नदी। बहरामा बहुजला तापसाचरिता शिवा॥
en: In this quarter lies the sacred and auspicious river Godavari which is full of much water, which abounds in groves and which is frequented by the ascetics.

sa: प्राग् द्वादशसमा राजन्धार्तराष्ट्रान् निहन्महि। निवर्त्य च वनात् पार्थमानाय्य च जनार्दनम्॥
en: Calling back Partha and Janardana, let us, O king, go away from the forest and slay the descendants of Dhritarashtra even before the expiry of pledged period of twelve years.

sa: अथास्य दारानिच्छन्ति परिभूय क्षमावतः। दाराश्चास्य प्रवर्तन्ते यथाकाममचेतसः॥
en: Disregarding him even they wish to have the wife of a forgiving person and his wife too does whatever she likes.

sa: आपतन्ती तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य गन्धर्वाणां महाचमूम्॥ महता शरवर्षेण राधेयः प्रत्यवारयत्।
en: Seeing that the the great army army of the Gandharvas was rushing towards him, the son of Radha stopped them with a very large shower of arrows.

sa: बन्धुवाच एक एवग्निर्बहुधा समिध्यते एकः सूर्यः सर्वमिदं विभाति। एको वीरो दोवराजऽरिन्ता यमः पितृणामीश्वरश्चैक एव॥
en: Bandi said: Fire is only one which blazes in various forms, One is the sun that illuminates the universe, One is the hero, Indra, the lord of the celestials who destroys all enemies, One is Yama, the sole lord of the Pitris.

sa: आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा अश्विनौ समरुद्गणौ। रक्षन्तु त्वां महाभागेधर्मेणासि समावृता॥
en: O noble-hearted one! may the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the twin Asvinis together with the wind-gods, protect you! Or you are protected by yours own virtue!'

sa: कोपसंरक्तनयनः कथमित्यब्रवीद् वचः। द्वितीयमपराध्यन्तं भीमं श्रुत्वाधनेश्वरः॥
en: And with eyes reddened with ire, exclaimed "what.” And the Lord of wealth hearing of Bhima's second offence,

sa: भीमसेनस्य न ग्लानिर्विक्षतस्यापि राक्षसैः। आसीत् तस्यामवस्थायां कुबेरमपि पश्यतः॥
en: Bhimasena did not experience any depression of mind (either) on account of his being wounded by the Rakshasas (or) seeing Kubera in that state.

sa: तत्राभिषेकं यः कुर्यात् पितृदेवार्चने रतः। अश्वमेधाद् दशगुणं फलं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The wise men say that those that bathe in it in honour of the Pitris and the celestials obtain ten times the fruits of the Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: कामभोगैः प्रियीनां हीनां बन्धुजनेन च। देहं संधारयन्ती हि भर्तृदर्शनकाझ्या॥
en: Deprived of all the delightful objects of enjoyments and separated from friends and relatives, she lives a miserable life, cherishing the hope of beholding her husband again.

sa: गच्छ पाण्डवशार्दूल रत्नान्यादाय सर्वशः। अविघ्नमस्तु कार्याय धर्मराजाय धीमते॥
en: "O best of the Pandavas, go (back) on receiving wealth from us. Let the work of the intelligent Dharmaraja be accomplished without any hindrance."

sa: स तथाक्षेषु कुशलो निश्चितो गतचेतनः। चरिष्यसि महाराज वनेषु वसतीः पुनः॥
en: He (the king) is unskilled at dice and beyond doubt he looses his senses when at dice. Therefore, O great monarch, you shall have again to live in the woods.

sa: तं भार्या प्रत्युवाचाथधर्ममेवानुतन्वती। वैन्यं गत्वा महात्मानमर्थयस्वधनं बहु॥
en: To this his wife, actuated by virtuous motives, also replied “go to the high-souled Vainya and beg of him immense wealth.

sa: तत्रोदपानधर्मज्ञ सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्। समुद्रास्तत्र चत्वारः कूपे संनिहिताः सदा॥
en: O virtuous man, there is a well which is capable of destroying all sins; in that well four seas always dwell.

sa: पातयन्नुत्तमाङ्गानि गन्धर्वाणां महारथः॥ क्षणेन व्यधमत् सर्वां चित्रसेनस्य वाहिनीम्।
en: That great car-warrior cut off within a moment the heads of many Gandharvas and thus they made the army of Chitrasena yell in pain.

sa: प्राप्स्यामः फलमत्यन्तं बहुलं निरुपद्रवम्। अरण्यगमनं क्षिप्रं रोचतां वो गुणाधिकम्॥
en: May it be your inclination to go to the forests soon; because (by repairing there) we shall attain the highly blissful and tranquil fulfillment (of our desires).

sa: द्वेषयामासुरन्योन्यं हृषितैर्विजयावहैः। स तामस्थाय भगवान् राजराजो महारथम्॥ प्रययौ देवगन्धर्वैः स्तूयमानो महाद्युतिः। तं प्रयान्तं महात्मानं सर्वे यक्षाधनाधिपम्॥ रक्ताक्षा हेमसंकाशा महाकाया महाबलाः। सायुधा बद्धनिस्त्रिंशा यक्षा दशशतावराः॥
en: And began to send forth neighs at each other indicative of victory. (And) that resplendent and divine king of kings, ascending the mighty car and being eulogised by the celestials and the Gandharvas, set out. A thousand principal Yakshas, of reddened eyes, golden lustre and huge structure, possessed of vast strength and equipped with weapons and girding on their swords, followed the noble-minded lord of wealth and king of all the Yakshas.

sa: प्राप्य भार्यामगस्त्यस्तु लोपामुद्रामभाषत। महार्हाण्युत्सृजैतानि वासांस्याभरणानि च॥
en: Having received Lopamudra as his wife, Agastya thus spoke to her. “Throw away these costly robes and ornaments."

sa: नैतावता कृतमित्यब्रवीत् तं वृकोदरः संनिवृत्तार्धकायः। शीघ्रं हि त्वां निहतं सानुबन्ध संस्मार्याहं प्रतिवक्ष्यामि मूढ॥
en: Thereupon, Vrikodara(Bhima), half turning towards him, said. “O fool, do not think that by this you gain any ascendancy over me. I shall soon kill you with all your followers and answer you recalling all this to your mind”.

sa: लोपामुद्रोवाच अल्पावशिष्टः कालोऽयमृतोर्मम तपोधन। न चान्यथाहमिच्छामि त्वामुपैतुं कथंचन॥
en: Lopamudra said : O great ascetic, my season will not last long. I do not desire to live with you at any other time.

sa: वयश्च समतीतं मे सभार्यस्य द्विजोत्तमा आसां प्राणा: समायत्ता मम चात्रैकपुत्रके॥
en: O excellent Brahmana, I am grown old in years and so are my wives. This only one son is like the breadth of their nostrils; so is he to me.

sa: तस्याप्रतिहतं चक्रं प्रावर्तत महात्मनः। रत्नानि चैव राजर्षि स्वयमेवोपतस्थिरे॥
en: The wheel of that high-souled king's car was irresistible in its course. Gems and jewels came to that royal sage of their own accord.

sa: एवमुक्तः स भगवान् मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः। उवाच सुमहातेजाः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः॥
en: Thus addressed, the highly energetic and divine Markandeya of great austerities and well versed in all the departments of religious writs replied (to them).

sa: भैक्ष्यचर्या न विहिता न च विट्शूद्रजीविका। क्षत्रियस्य विशेषेणधर्मस्तु बलमौरसम्॥
en: It is not proper for you to lead a life of mendicancy or the life of Shudra. Prowess and energy constitute the special virtue of the Kshatriya.

sa: काश्मीराश्च कुमाराश्च घोरका हंसकायनाः। शिवित्रिगर्तयौधेया राजन्या भद्रकेकयाः॥
en: The Kashmiras, the Kumaras, the Ghorakas, the Hansakayanas, the Shibis the Trigartas, the Yaudheyas, the rulers of the Madras, the Kaikeyas,

sa: उदारमेव विद्वांसोधर्मं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः। उदारं प्रतिपद्यस्व नावरे स्थातुमर्हसि॥
en: The wise and learned man says that prosperity is virtue. Therefore, acquire prosperity, for you ought not to be in frivolity.

sa: आयुष्मन्नुपदेशस्तु सारथ्ये वर्ततां स्मृतः। सर्वार्थेषु रथी रक्ष्यस्त्वं चापि भृशपीडितः॥
en: O hero of long life, those that are placed as charioteers (on the cars) are taught to protect the warriors on their chariots. You were greatly afflicted.

sa: तस्मादपचितः पार्थ लोके हास्यं गमिष्यसि। स्वधर्माद्धि मनुष्याणां चलनं न प्रशस्यते॥
en: O son of Pritha, if you fall off from it, you will be the laughing stock (of all men). Deviation from the duties of one's own (order) is never praised.

sa: ततः सर्वे महाबाहु समासाद्य वृकोदरम्। तेजोयुक्तमपृच्छन्त कस्त्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Thereupon they all came to the mightyarmed and effulgent Vrikodara (Bhima) and asked, "Who are you? you should answer our question.

sa: सोमाविश्विनावेतौ यथा वाद्य कृतौ त्वया। भूय एव तु ते वीर्यं प्रकाशेदिति भार्गव॥
en: O son of Bhrigu, these two Ashvins are now entitled to drink the Soma juice as you have made them today. O son of Bhrigu, I have done it to spread the fame of your powers.

sa: इमे सद्धर्ममाहात्म्ययशोवीर्यानुवर्तिनः। नार्हन्ति व्यसनं भोक्तुं नन्वेषां क्रियतां दया!॥
en: These my sons are ever attached to virtue, nobility, good fame and prowess. They do not deserve to suffer afflictions. Show kindness towards them.

sa: स्वधर्म इति कृत्वा तु न त्यजामि द्विजोत्तम। पुरा कृतमिति ज्ञात्वा जीवाम्येतेन कर्मणा॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, knowing this to be the duty of my order, I do not give it up. Knowing this to be the result of my own acts, I earn my livelihood by doing it.

sa: शत्रूणां ये प्राणहराः सुखं येन हनिष्यथ। एवमाभाष्य हनुमांस्तदा पाण्डवनन्दनम्॥ मार्गमाख्याय भीमाय तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Which will damp the courage of your enemies. You will then be able to destroy them with ease.” Having thus spoken to the son of Pandu, Hanuman first pointed out to him the way and disappeared.

sa: तेषामापततां वेग: करिणां दुःसहोऽभवत्। नगाचादिव शीर्णानां शृङ्गाणां पततां क्षितौ।॥
en: The violence of the forward rush of these elephants became intolerable, even as the fall of the peaks, broken from the mountain tops, directed towards the ground.

sa: यद्येतदेवमज्ञास्यं वने वासो हि वि ध्रुवम्। शतशृङ्गन्मृते पाण्डौ नागमिष्यं गजाह्वयम्॥
en: If I had known before that you were destined to live in the forest, I would not have (then) come after Pandu's death from the mountains of Shatashringa to Hastinapur.

sa: बहु लोके विपर्यस्तं दृश्यते द्विजसत्तम। धर्मयुक्तमधर्मं च तत्र किं प्रतिभाति ते॥
en: Such reverses of the natural orders of things, O foremost of Brahmanas, are always seen (in this world). What is your opinion as to the virtuousness or otherwise of this state of things?

sa: ततो वृत्रवधे यत्नमकुर्वंस्त्रिदशाः पुरा। पुरंदरं पुरस्कृत्य ब्रह्माणमुपतस्थिरे॥
en: Thereupon the celestials resolved upon the destruction of Vritra and they all went to Brahma with Purandra (Indra) at their head.

sa: सम्यक् प्रणीतदण्डा हि कामद्वेषविवर्जिताः। अलुब्धा विगतक्रोधाः सतां यान्ति सलोकताम्॥
en: Being not influenced by lust, malice, avarice and anger, if kings justly and properly punish (their subjects), they then go to the place where virtuous men go.

sa: कुमुदैः पुण्डरीकैश्च शीतवारिधराः शिवाः। नदीः पुष्करिणीश्चैव ददृशुः समलंकृताः॥
en: And (the Pandavas) beheld the rivers and the tanks, full of cool water and beautified with lilies and lotuses and pleasant (to the eye)

sa: अपेयात् किल भाः सूर्याल्लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रमसस्तथा। इति लोको व्यवसितो दृष्ट्वेमां भवतो व्यथाम्॥
en: Seeing your this affliction, (the people of) the world have come to this conclusion that light may (some day) forsake the sun and beauty may (some day) forsake the moon.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। मोहयिष्यन् दानवानामहं मायाबलं महत्॥
en: Hearing these words (of Matali) and pacifying my mind with my own efforts and deliberating (within myself) how to battle this mighty illusion created by the Danavas,

sa: स्वेभ्यश्चैव परेभ्यश्च कार्याकार्यसमुद्भवा। बुद्धिः कर्मसु विज्ञेया रिपूणां च बलाबलम्॥ बुद्ध्या स्वप्रतिपन्नेषु कुर्यात् साधुष्वनुग्रहम्। निग्रहं चाप्यशिष्टेषु निर्मर्यादेषु कारयेत्॥
en: Propriety and impropriety of the resolution of the enemy, as also their strength and weakness should be ascertain through one's own spies as well as the spies of the enemies. Favour should be shown to honest persons that have prudently sought protection. But lawless and disobedient persons should always be punished.

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्रीते त्वयि महाभाग सर्वलोकाभिपूजिते। कृतमेतावता मन्ये यदहं दृष्टवान् प्रभुम्॥
en: Bhishma said: O greatly exalted one, () worshipped of all the world, when you are pleased with me and when I have got a sight of you. I consider myself crowned with success.

sa: तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वाणः पितृदेवार्चने रतः। हयमेधमवाप्नोति शक्रलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and goes to the region of Sakra (Indra).

sa: राजापि च स्मयन् भीमो मनसा समचिन्तयन्। अधिकं योजनशतं तस्यागमनकारणम्॥ ग्रमान् बहूनतिक्रम्य नाध्यगच्छद् यथातथम्। अल्पकार्य विनिर्दिष्टं तस्यागमनकारणम्॥
en: Struck with amazement, king Bhima reflected on the cause of Rituparna's visit, who had travelled more than a hundred yojanas. Bhima supposed, “That simply to pay him respects was not the reason of his coming there, after having passed over so many monarchs and crossed over countless villages.

sa: इति लोके निर्वचनं पुरश्चरति भारत। अपि चैताः स्त्रियो बाला: स्वाध्यायमधिकुर्वते॥
en: Thus talk the people among one another. O descendant of Bharata, even women and children are repeating it, as if it were a lesson they wanted to commit to memory.

sa: अनुकीर्णानि रक्षोभिस्तेभ्यो नस्त्रातुमर्हसि। तीर्थान्युक्तानिधौम्येन नारदेन चधीमता॥ यान्युवाच च देवर्षिर्लोमशः सुमहातपाः। विधिवत् तानि सर्वाणि पर्यटस्व नराधिप॥ धूतपाप्मा सहास्माभिर्लोमशेनाभिपालितः। स राजा पूज्यमानस्तैर्हर्षादश्रुपरिप्लुतः॥ भीमसेनादिभिवीरैर्धातृभिः परिवारितः। बाढमित्यब्रवीत् सर्वांस्तानृषीन् पाण्डवर्षभः॥
en: O ruler of men visit all the Tirthas spoken of by the greatly intelligent Dhaumya and also those spoken of by the greatly ascetic celestials Rishi Lomasha. Protected by Lomasha and accompanied by us, be cleansed of all sins.” Having been thus addressed by them, the king (Yudhishthira) was filled with tears of joy. Surrounded by his heroic brothers headed by Bhimasena that foremost of Pandavas (Yudhishthira) said to all those Rishis “So be it."

sa: नारदस्त्वथ देवर्षित्वा तांस्तु कृतक्षणान्। मार्कण्डेयस्य वदतस्तां कथामन्वमोदत॥
en: Learning that they were about to hear the words of Markandeya, the divine saint Narada signified his assent to the proposal.

sa: पाड्यमानासु मायासु तासु तास्वसुरोत्तमाः। पुनर्बहुविधा मायाः प्राकुर्वन्नमितौजसः॥
en: That illusion being dispelled, some of the foremost amongst the Asuras, possessed of unrivalled prowess, again created various sorts of illusions,

sa: व्यक्तं ते विदितो राजत्रों द्रव्यपरिग्रहः। प्रकृतिं चापि वेत्थास्य विकृतिं चापि भूयसीम्॥
en: O king, it is evident that you know that pleasure is to be derived from virtuous objects of enjoyments. You also know (what) their ordinary states as well as their great changes (are).

sa: मूढो नैकृतिकश्चापि चपलश्च द्विजोत्तम। सुखदुःखविपर्यासान् सदा समुपपद्यते॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, the foolish men, designing men and the fickle men attain the very reverse of happiness or misery.

sa: गोवासना ब्राह्मणाश्च दासनीयाश्च सर्वशः। प्रीत्यर्थं ते महाराज धर्मराज्ञो महात्मनः॥
en: O great king, many Brahmanas, who rear cattle and who are fit to be engaged in menial service, in order to gratify the illustrious Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) waited,

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ वसोर्धारामभिष्टुताम्। गमनादेव तस्यां हि हयमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: O virtuous king, one should then go to Vasudhara which is worshipped by all. He who goes there obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha (sacrifice).

sa: दुःशासन सुबालोऽयं विकर्णः प्राज्ञवादिकः। पाण्डवानां च वासांसि द्रौपद्याश्चाप्युहर॥
en: O Dushasana, this Vikarna, speaking words of wisdom, is but a boy. Take off the robes of the Pandavas and also that of Draupadi.

sa: देवर्षयस्तथा यक्षा देवाश्चात्र वृकोदर। आमन्त्र्य यक्षप्रवरं पिबन्ति रमयन्ति च। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव विहरन्त्यत्र पाण्डव॥
en: O Vrikodara, the celestials Rishis, the Yakshas and the celestials, after taking permission of the Yaksha chief, drink the water of this lake and sport here. O Pandava, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras (also) sport here.

sa: प्रभासादीनि तीर्थानि महेन्द्रादींश्च पर्वतान्। गङ्गाद्याः सरितश्चैव प्लक्षादींश्च वनस्पतीन्॥ त्वया सह महीपाल द्रष्टुमिच्छामहे वयम्। यदि ते ब्राह्मणेष्वस्ति काचित् प्रीतिर्जनाधिप।॥
en: Prabhasa and other Tirthas, Mahendra and other mountains, Ganga and other rivers, Plaksha and other lords of forests (trees). O great king, we desire to see all these with you. O ruler of men, if you have any regard of the Brahmanas. Then speedily do what we say. You will obtain prosperity through it.

sa: दत्तवेतनभक्तं च दत्तायुधपरिच्छदम्। कृतोपधानं च तदा बलमासीन्महाभुज॥
en: O mighty-arined hero, the soldiers were all gratified with the allowances, wages, rations, weapons and dresses (that were given to them).

sa: इहाप्लुतानां कौन्तेय सद्यः पाप्माभिहन्यते। कुरुश्रेष्ठाभिषेकं वै तस्मात् कुरु सहानुजः॥
en: O son of Kunti, if one bathes here his sins are immediately destroyed. O foremost of the Kurus, therefore perform your oblations here with your younger brothers.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा लोकपालास्ते भ्राजमानं यथा रविम्। तस्युर्विगतसंकल्पा विस्मिता रूपसम्पदा॥
en: The Lokapalas, having seen him resplendent as the sun, were struck with astonishment at his wealth of beauty; and they, therefore, abandoned their idea (of getting her).

sa: समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यायंधर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। पप्रच्छागमने हेतुमटने च प्रयोजनम्॥
en: Having duly adored him, the son of Dharma Yudhishthira asked the reason of his arrival and the object of his wandering.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच भीमस्य वाक्ये तद्वदेवार्जुनस्य स्थितोऽहं वै यमयोश्चैवमेव। मथो दास्यान्मोक्ष्यसे याज्ञसेनि॥
en: Duryodhana said I am willing to abide by the words of Bhima, Arjuna and the twins. Let them say that Yudhisthira is not their master; and Yajnaseni will (then) be freed from slavery.

sa: ते द्वादशं वर्षमुपोपयातं वने विहर्तुं कुरवः प्रतीताः। तस्माद् वनाच्चैत्ररथप्रकाशात श्रिया ज्वलन्तस्तपसा च युक्ताः॥ ततश्च यात्वा मरुधन्वपार्श्व सदाधनुर्वेदरतिप्रधानाः। सरस्वतीमेत्य निवासकामाः सरस्ततो द्वैतवनं प्रतीयुः॥
en: And when the twelfth of their forest life had arrived, those descendants of the Kurus, blazing in splendour, engaged in asceticism and given principally to the practice of archery, leaving that forest looking like that of Chitraratha, repaired gladly towards the confines of the desert. Thence they arrived at the banks of the river Sarasvati and therefrom desirous of dwelling there repaired to the Lake Dvaitavana.

sa: मृषानुशासिनः पापा मृषावादपरायणाः। आन्ध्राः शकाः पुलिन्दाश्च यवनाश्च नराधिपाः॥
en: These sinful kings addicted to falsehood will govern their subjects on principles that are false. The Andhras, the Shakas, the Pulandas, the Yavana kings,

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं नागायुतप्राणो भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। भयमाहारयत् तीव्र तस्मादजगरान्मुने॥
en: Janamejaya said : O sage, why did the terribly powerful Bhima endued with the strength of ten thousand elephants entertain such a dreadful fear of that snake!

sa: नभो वितिमिरं कुर्वञ्जलदान् पाटयन्निव। दिशः सम्पूरयन् नादैर्महामेघरवोपमैः॥
en: Making the sky devastated of darkness, dividing the clouds and filling the quarters with a sound resembling that of huge clouds.

sa: मुवाचेदं धृतराष्ट्रो नरेन्द्रः। युधिष्ठिरं राजपुत्रं च गत्वा मद्वाक्येन क्षिप्रमिहानयस्व॥
en: Thereupon the ruler of men, Dhritarashtra, thus spoke to his chief minister, the learned Vidura, “Going (to Indraprastha), soon bring the prince Yudhishthira here at my command.

sa: ऋधिर्महान् महाभागो जमदग्निर्महायशाः। पलाशकेषु पुण्येषु रम्येष्वयजत प्रभुः॥
en: Here also is the sacred and charming Palasaka where the greatly exalted, the highly illustrious great Rishi lord Jamadagni performed sacrifices.

sa: धुन्धोर्वधात् तदा राजा कुवलाश्वो महामनाः॥ धुन्धुमार इति ख्यातो नाम्नाप्रतिरथोऽभवत्।
en: And from that day the lofty-minded king Kuvalashva became known by the name of Dhundhumara and was thought to be unconquerable on account of his slaying Dhundhu.

sa: पक्षिणामिव निर्घोषः कुबेरसदनं प्रति। बभूव परमाश्वानामैरावतपथे यथा॥
en: As the excellent horses (swift) as birds proceeded towards the abode of Kubera a noise arose in the region of Indra.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो महाबाहुर्विधिवत् कुरुनन्दनः। कौबेरमधिजग्राह दिव्यमस्त्रं महाबलः॥
en: Thereupon the mighty-armed and the highly powerful descendant of Kuru, Arjuna duly received that celestials weapon of Kubera.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं हि त्वया दृष्ट ऋषिर्गच्छन् महातपाः। मार्कण्डेयोऽप्रमेयात्माधर्मेण चिरजीविता॥
en: You have seen with your own eyes the great ascetic Markandeya of incomparable magnanimity come to us who has been rendered immortal by virtue.

sa: एष ह्यस्य महाबाहुस्तेजोऽशश्च हरेधुंवम्। तमेव पुनरादातुमिच्छत्युत तथा विभुः॥
en: This mighty armed (hero) is certainly a portion of Hari's (Krishna) energy. The lord (Krishna) wishes to take back to himself his that energy.

sa: तत्राभिगम्य चेशानं गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्। महादेवप्रसादाच्च गाणपत्यं च विन्दति॥ समृद्धमसपत्नं च श्रिया युक्तं नरोत्तमः।
en: Going there he beholds Ishana and obtains the fruit of (giving away) one thousand kine. Through the grace of Mahadeva (Shiva), he obtains the state of Ganapatya. That foremost of man becomes blessed with prosperity, peace and highest grace.

sa: वेदाध्यायीधर्मपरः कुले जातो मनस्विनि। स्थविरेषु स योक्तव्यो राजर्षिर्धर्मचारिभिः॥
en: O large-minded lady, one studying the Vedas, virtuous and born in a high race, (though young) is considered aged by the pious royal saints.

sa: ततः प्रत्यक्षतो दृष्ट्वा पक्षिणस्ते समीपगाः। निजघ्नुस्तं तदा हंसं मिथ्यावृत्तं कुरूद्वह॥
en: O excellent Puru, then all those birds, witnessing with their own eyes the act of the (old), swan, came to him, and they then killed that wretch of false conduct.

sa: ततो नाज्ञायत तदा दिवारानं तथा दिशः। ततोऽहं मोहमापन्नः प्रज्ञास्त्रं समयोजयम्॥
en: None could ascertain whether it was then day or night. None could distinguish even the points of heaven. Thereupon becoming bewildered, I fixed on my bowstring the weapon, named Prajnastra.

sa: सा शङ्कमाना तत् पापं चिकीर्षन्ती च तत्प्रियम्। नलं च हृतसर्वस्वमुपलभ्येदमब्रवीत्॥ बृहत्सेनामतियशां तांधात्री परिचारिकाम्। हितां सर्वार्थकुशलामनुरक्तां सुभाषिताम्॥
en: Beholding Nala deprived of all his possessions and being afraid of the calamity that had befallen her husband and desirous of doing good to him, Damayanti addressed to her nurse and maid-servant who was most noted, well-meaning beloved and intent upon doing good to all and well-speaking-these words-

sa: अथास्य भक्ष्यमाजहः समुद्रजलचारिणः। अण्डजा भीष्म तस्मान्ये धर्मार्थमिति शुश्रुम॥
en: O Bhishma, it has been heard by us that oviparous creatures, (all) dwelling in the sea, brought him food for the sake of virtue.

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ तीर्थसेवनतत्परः। शिखरं वै महादेव्या गौर्यास्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्॥
en: O virtuous man, the pilgrim should then go to the peak of the great goddess Gauri, celebrated all over the world.

sa: ब्रह्मदत्तवरः स्कन्द त्वयायं महिषो हतः। देवास्तृणसमा यस्य बभूवुर्जयतां वर॥
en: "O Skanda, O foremost of all warriors, this Mahisha who was made invincible by Brahma is (now) killed by you. The celestials were like grass to him.

sa: सरस्वती महापुण्या ह्रदिनी तीर्थमालिनी। समुद्रगा महावेगा यमुना यत्र पाण्डव॥
en: O son of Pandu, here flows the greatly sacred Sarasvati abounding in Tirthas and banks, easy of ascent. Here also flows the ocean going and impetuous Yamuna.

sa: नल उवाच भवद्भिरहमादिष्टो दमयन्त्या निवेशनम्। प्रविष्टः सुमहाकक्षं दण्डिभिः स्थविरैर्वृतम्॥
en: Nala said: At your behest, I entered the mansion of Damayanti consisting of large and beautiful chambers and guarded by old guards with bludgeons in their hands.

sa: वयं तु शस्त्राण्यादाय रथानास्थाय दंशिताः। गच्छामः सहिता हन्तुं पाण्डवान् वनगोचरान्॥
en: Let us now, attired in our armours and armed with our weapons, mount on our chariot and go in a body to kill the Pandavas now living in the forest.

sa: राज्ञा मूर्धन्युपाघ्रातास्ते च कौरवनन्दनाः। चत्वारः पाण्डवा राजन् भीमसेनपुरोगमा:॥
en: O king, the monarch (Dhritarashtra) smelt his head as also those of the four other Kuru princes, the Pandavas, Bhima being at their head.

sa: शतसाहस्रकं तीर्थं तत्रैव भरतर्षभ॥ तत्रोपस्पर्शनं कृत्वा नियतो नियताशनः। गोसहस्रफलं पुण्यं प्राप्नोति भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, there is a Tirtha called Satasahasraka. Bathing there with regulated diet and subdued soul. O best of the Bharata race, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: समदैश्चापि विहगैः पादपैरन्वितास्तथा। तेऽवतीर्य बहून् देशानुत्तमच्छिसमन्वितान्॥
en: Adorned with various trees and enraptured birds. Having passed many such regions and also the country of Uttara-Kurus.

sa: भवानन्यद् वनं साधु बह्वन्नं फलवच्छुचि। आख्यातु रामणीयं च सेवितं पुण्यकर्मभिः॥
en: Therefore, you, (O Rishis), speak of some other forest which is sacred and delightful and which abounds in fruits and food and which is inhabited by men of pious deeds,

sa: अभिरूपं महात्मानं परव्यूहविनाशनम्। यमन्वेषसि राजानं नलं पद्मनिभेक्षणम्॥ अयं स इति कस्याद्य श्रोष्यामि मधुरां गिरम्।
en: From whose lips shall I this day hear these honeyed words viz. 'That graceful and highsouled king Nala of eyes resembling lotus leaves, the slayer of hostile troops, in quest of whom you are wandering in this forest, is staying even here.'

sa: नाभुक्तवति नास्नाते नासंविष्टे च भर्तरि। न संविशामि नाश्नामि सदा कर्मकरेष्वपि॥
en: I never bathe or eat or sleep till he that is my husband has bathed or eaten or slept, till all our servants and followers have bathed, eaten and slept.

sa: स भक्षयिष्यन् संक्रुद्धः शतक्रतुमुपाद्रवत्। महता घोररूपेण लोकाञ्छब्देन नादयन्॥
en: He rushed upon Shatakratu (Indra) with the intention of devouring that deity. The worlds resounded with the loud and fearful roaring of that Asura.

sa: नाममिष्यन्ति तेधीरा अकृत्वा कालसंविदम्। आगमिष्यन्ति चेन्मोहात् पुन तेन ताञ्जय॥
en: These self-controlled men (the Pandavas) will never return without living in the exile) the promised period. If however they come from delusion, defeat them again at dice.

sa: यतो बुद्धिस्ततः शान्तिः प्रशमं गच्छ भारत। नादारुणि पतेच्छस्त्रं दारुण्येतन्निपात्यते॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, where there is intelligence there is forbearance. Therefore follow the path of peace. Axe falls upon wood, it does not fall upon stone.

sa: सर्वे भवामो मध्यस्था राज्ञश्छन्दानुवर्तिनः। छिद्रं बहु प्रपश्यन्तः पाण्डवानां सुसंवृताः॥
en: Assuming an aspect of neutrality and in apparent obedience to the will of the king (Dhritarashtra), we, keeping our counsels to ourselves, will closely watch the Pandavas.

sa: हतेषु भारतेष्वाजौ कुरूणां गुरवस्तदा। एवं सामानि गास्यन्तीत्युक्त्वा धौम्योऽपि गच्छति॥२३
en: Dhaumya is preceding, saying "When the descendant of Bharata will be killed in battle, the priests and preceptors of the Kurus will thus sing the Sama Mantras."

sa: स वा प्रवेश्यतां माताँ वानुज्ञातुमर्हसि। विदितं वाथवा ज्ञातं पितुर्मे संविधीयताम्॥
en: O mother, with or without the knowledge of my father, make this arrangement for me; either allow him to enter my mansion or give me permission to go to him.”

sa: तत्र वृक्षतृणाद्यैश्च सम्पन्नः फलमूलवान्। आश्रमोऽगस्त्यशिष्यस्य पुण्यो देवसमो गिरिः॥
en: Near to that Tirtha is the sacred hermitage of Agastya's disciple, the mountain Devasama which abounds in trees and grass and fruits and roots.

sa: लोकपालेषु यातेषु मामुवाचाथ मातलिः। द्रष्टुमिच्छति शक्रस्त्वां देवराजो महायुते॥
en: The Lokapalas having gone away, Matali said to me “O you of unrivalled splendour, the lord of the celestials, Sakra, wishes to see you.

sa: युधिष्ठिराभिषेकं च वासुदेवस्य चाहणम्। न स्याद् यथा तथा कार्यमेवं सर्वे तदाब्रुवन्॥
en: They all said, “We must act in such a way as the final sacrificial rites to be performed by Yudhishthira and this worship of Krishna may not be supposed to have our acquiescence”.

sa: न चापश्यंस्ततोऽन्योन्यं तमसावृतचक्षुषः। आकृष्यमाणा वातेन साश्मचूर्णेन भारत॥
en: With eyes enveloped in darkness and pushed by the wind full of particles of rocks, they could not see one another.

sa: प्लक्षानुदुम्बरबटानश्वत्थान् क्षीरिकांस्तथा। भल्लातकानामलकीहरीतकबिभीतकान्॥
en: Plaksha, Udumbaras, Vata, Asvattha, Khirika, Bhallataka, Amalaki, Haritaki, Bhibhitaki,

sa: मेघरूपी च वातापि: कामरूप्यभवत् क्षणात्। संस्कृत्य च भोजयति ततो विप्रं जिघांसति॥
en: Vatapi who was capable of assuming any form at will at once assumed the form of a goat. After being cooked that food was given to the Brahmanas in order to kill them.

sa: अदृश्यरूपा वचाश्चाप्यब्रुवन् साधु साध्विति। आविध्यदजितं कृष्णं भविष्यद्भूतजल्पकः॥
en: An invisible voice said, “Excellent, Excellent!" Clad in a black deer skin, the speaker of both the past and the future,

sa: एतदासीत् तदा राज्ञो यन्महीं पर्यपालयत्। येषां संख्याविधिं चैव प्रदिशामि शृणोमि च॥ अन्तःपुराणां सर्वेषां भृत्यानां चैव सर्वशः। आगोपालाविपालेभ्यः सर्वं वेद कृताकृतम्॥ सर्वं राज्ञः समुदयमायं च व्ययमेव च। एकाहं वेधि कल्याणि पाण्डवानां यशस्विनि॥
en: Such was the procession of Yudhishthira when he ruled over earth. It was I who regulated their number and formed the rules to be observed in respect to them. It was I who had to listen to all their complaints. I knew everything about the maid-servants of the palace and other servants, nay even of the cowherds and shepherds of the royal household. O blessed and illustrious lady, it was I alone among the Pandavas who knew the (real) income and expenditure of the king and what (really) their (Pandavas') whole income was.

sa: यस्मिन् जनो हव्यभुजं जुहोति गोब्राह्मणं चार्चति देवताश्च। काले च पुष्पैर्बलयः क्रियन्ते तस्मिन् गृहे नित्यमुपैमि वासम्॥
en: I always live in that house in which the inmate pours libations on the sacrificial fire and adore kine, Brahmanas, and the gods. I live in that house where at the proper time offerings are made, to the gods, of flowers in course of worship.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः संवादिते तस्मिन्ननुज्ञातो धनंजयः। गतां रैवतके कन्यां विदित्वा जनमेजयः॥शा वासुदेवाभ्यनुज्ञातः कथयित्वेतिकृत्यताम्। कृष्णस्य मतमादायः प्रययौ भरतर्षभः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Janamejaya, having received information of the assent (of Yudhishthira) and learning that the maiden had gone on the Raivataka (hill), Dhananjaya (Arjuna). That best of the Bharata race, obtained the assent of Vasudeva (Krishna) and also settled in consultation with him all that was to be done.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। अन्योन्यं वै प्रार्थयतां योधानामर्जुनस्य च॥
en: Then the battle that raged between all those warriors on one side and Arjuna on the other, became exceeding fierce and hair-stirring, inasmuch as each desired to meet the other.

sa: ततः स भरतश्रेष्ठो गजापाणिरभिद्रवन्॥ प्रमथिष्यन्निव शिरो भीमसेनस्य संयुगे।
en: That best of the line of Bharata then rushed at Bhimasena, as if he would crush the head of his opponent in that battle,

sa: इति तद् धनुरानम्य शुल्कावाप्तं महाबलः। भ्रात्रा भीमेन सहितस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
en: Having said this, the mighty Arjuna took up the bow he had obtained as the dower and accompanied by his brother Bhima, stood immovable as a mountain.

sa: यः स भूरिश्रवााश्छिन्नभुजः प्रायगतस्त्वया॥ वार्यमाणेन हि हतस्ततः पापतरं नु किम्।
en: What act can be more unrighteous than that perpetrated by you when, repeatedly prevented, you slew Bhurisrava, whose arm was lopped off and who had betaken to the Praya Yoga?

sa: स तस्य चापनि?षात्कुपितो राक्षसर्षभः। अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमभिदुद्राव राघवम् ॥
en: And fired with wrath at the twang of his bow, that foremost of Raksasas, inflamed with wrath, not brooking that report, rushed against Rāghava.

sa: अयुध्यमानं यस्त्वाजौ तथा प्रायगतं मुनिम्॥ छिन्नबाहुं परैर्हन्यात् सात्यके स कथं वेदत्।
en: How can he, O Satyaki, censure such as act, who himself has slain his opponent, desisted from battle an opponent that was sitting in Praya Yoga and whose arm was cut-off by another.

sa: विभ्राजते चातिमात्रं किरीटं विचित्रमेतच्च धनंजयस्य। दिवाकराभो मणिरेष दिव्यो विभ्राजते चैव किरीटसंस्थः॥
en: There, the resplendent beauty of Dhananjaya's diadem is shedding its effulgence brightly and the bright luster of the gem-studded on it. Sparkling with the radiancy of the Sun, is looking much more resplendent.

sa: इदं ममापरं वाक्यं शृणु राजन्यदीच्छसि। उपायकुशलो ह्येव जयेच्छवूनतन्द्रितः॥
en: O monarch, if you are minded, hear this other word of mine! Verily he that is fertile in resources and ever ready, compass success.

sa: स चाप्येतद् विजानाति वासुदेवार्जुनौ तथा। दुर्योधनसमो नास्ति गदायामिति निश्चयः॥
en: It is very well known to both Vasudeva and Arjuna that it is certain that in a fight with the mace there is none equal to Duryodhana.

sa: ततस्तु रक्षः क्षतजावलिप्तं वित्रासनं देवमहाचमूनाम्। व्याविध्य तं मुद्गरमुग्रवेगं विद्रावयामास चमूं हरीणाम्॥
en: Then that Rākşasa whirling his mace washed in blood, capable of striking terror into the mighty hosts of gods and Dānavas, and possessed of fierce impetus, made the monkeyarmy take to its heels.

sa: तां कश्यपस्यानुमते ब्राह्मणाः खण्डशस्तदा। व्यभजस्ते तदा राजन् प्रख्याताः खाण्डवायनाः॥
en: O king, then at the request of Kashyapa, the Brahmanas divided it into a number of shares and thus they came to be called the Khandavayanas (share-takers).

sa: विसूताश्वध्वजाः पेतुः संछिन्नायुधजीविताः। रथिनो स्थमुख्येभ्यः सहसा शरपीडिताः॥
en: Afflicted with those arrows, car warriors dropped down from their excellent chariots, deprived of horses and standards and weapons and life.

sa: ते वानरा भग्नहतावशेषाः पर्यन्तमाश्रित्य तदा विषण्णाः। प्रपीडिताङ्गा ददृशुः सुघोरं नरेन्द्ररक्षोधिपसंनिपातम्॥
en: Thereat the monkeys remaining after those broken and slain, dispirited, and having their limbs wounded, moving aside, looked on the dreadfiil encounter between the Rākşasa and the lord of men.

sa: नाभूमिदो भूमिमश्नाति राजन् नायानदो यानमारुह्य याति। यान् यान् कामान् ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददाति तांस्तान् कामान् जायमानः स भुङ्क्ते॥
en: O king, no one can enjoy landed property who does not give away lands; no one can drive on cars and conveyances who does not give them away. With whatever, desire one gives away to the Brahmanas, one enjoys the fruition of that gift in the next birth.

sa: ततो यज्ञेन महता जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। तर्पयामास देवेन्द्रमृत्विग्भ्यः प्रददौ महीम्॥
en: Then the mighty son of Jamadagni offered libations to the lord of the celestials in a great sacrifice, in which he bestowed the earth of the Ritvijas.

sa: कोटिशश्चैव रत्नानि तस्या गात्रे न्यवेशयत्। तां रत्नसंघातमयीमसृजद् देवरूपिणीम्॥
en: He placed millions of gems on the body of the damsel. The celestials beauty that he created was a mass of gems and jewels.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथितो धार्तराष्ट्राणामार्षः सम्भव उत्तमः। अमनुष्यो मनुष्याणां भवता ब्रह्मवादिना॥
en: Janamejaya said : O utterer of Brahma, you have recited the excellent account of the extraordinary births of the sons of Dhritarashtra on earth, the result of the Rishi grace.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचपतगोरगाः। सर्वे धर्षयितुं शक्याः किं पुनर्मानवौ रणे॥
en: I am competent to baffle in battle gods and Dänavas and Gandharvas, ghosts, birds and serpents, what then is a couple of human beings?

sa: बन्धनाच्चावसादान्मे श्रेयः प्रायोपवेशनम्। अनुजानन्तु मां सर्वे गृहं गच्छन्तु वानराः॥
en: For me fasting to death is better than being confined-and suffering the consequent misery. Do you grant me your permission; and go to your homes, you monkeys.

sa: तस्मिन्हते ब्राह्मणदेवशत्रौ महाबले संयति कुम्भकर्णे। चचाल भूर्भूमिधराश्च सर्वे हर्षाच्च देवास्स्तुमुलं प्रणेदुः॥
en: On that enemy of the Brāhmanas and gods, endowed with immense strength, having been slain in battle, the earth shook and the mountains also; and from excess of joy the celestials shouted aloud.

sa: धन्या त्वमसि पाञ्चालि या त्वं पुरुषसत्तमान्। उपतिष्ठसि कल्याणि महर्षीनिव गौतमी॥
en: And they said,-You deserve every praise, O blessed princess of Panchala, who wait by the side of these foremost of men like Gautaini by the side of the (seven) Rishis.

sa: तं सहस्रावरे काले शक्रो द्रष्टुमुपागमत्। तदेव च पुनर्वाक्यमुवाच बलवृत्रहा॥
en: After a thousand years had passed away, Shakra once more came to see him. Indeed the destroyer of Vala and Vritra laid to him the same words.

sa: उपवासं च दीक्षायामभिषेकं च पार्थिव। कृत्वा द्वादश वर्षाणि वीरस्थानाद् विशिष्यते॥
en: O king, by avoiding all but the prescribed diet while celebrating sacrifices, and by making pilgrimage for twelve years, one acquires a place better than the abodes reserved for heroes.

sa: अस्मिल्लोकै रौक्मिणेय तथामुष्मिंश्च पुत्रका ब्राह्मणप्रमुखं सौम्यं न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा॥
en: O child of Rukmini, whether in this or in the next world, O son, everything agrecable has originated from the Brahmanas. I have no doubt in this.

sa: यमाश्रित्य नरा राजन् वर्तयेयुर्थथासुखम्। अनाथास्तप्यमानाश्च दस्युभिः परिपीडिताः॥ तमेव पूजयेयुस्ते प्रीत्या स्वमिव बान्धवम्। अभीरभीक्ष्णं कौरव्य कर्ता सन्मानमर्हति॥
en: That person, O king, depending upon whom helpless men, oppressed and made miserable by robbers, live happily, deserves to be adored by all as if he were a near relative. The person, O you of Kuru's race, that removes the fears of others, is worthy of every respect.

sa: स एवं सर्वधर्मज्ञ मित्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्॥ नियच्छ मन्यु पाञ्चाल्यात् प्रशाम्य शिनिपुङ्गवा
en: Versed in the rules of duty, restrain your anger having the prince of the Panchalas for its object, remembering the duties that you owe to you friends.

sa: सम्मूढोऽस्मि भृशं तात श्रुत्वा कृष्णधनंजयौ। प्रविष्टौ मामकं सैन्यं सात्वतेन सहाच्युतौ॥
en: O son, I am indeed overwhelmed with a stupor upon hearing that Krishna and Arjuna of unfading glory together with Satyaki of the Satvata race, have entered into my divisions.

sa: तेभ्यो नमश्च भद्रं च ये शरीराणि जुह्वते। ब्रह्मद्विषो नियच्छन्तस्तेषां नोऽस्तु सलोकता। ब्रह्मलोकजितः स्वर्यान् वीरांस्तान् मनुरब्रवीत्।॥
en: I bow to them and blessed be they who thus renounce their lives while trying to punish the enemies of Brahmanas. Let us attain to that region which is reserved for them. Manu himself has said that those heroes go to the region of Brahman.

sa: अथ स्वावसथं गत्वा स शय्यास्तरणानि च। कन्याश्चालंकृता दग्ध्वा ततो व्यपगतः पुनः॥
en: One day, entering the quarters which were given to him, he burnt all the beds and coveriets and all the welladorned damsels who were there for serving him. Doing this, he went Out.

sa: मुनिः पायसदिग्धाङ्गी रथे तूर्णमयोजयत्। तमारुह्य रथं चैव निर्ययौ स गृहान्मम॥
en: The ascetic then caused your mother, whose body was sicared over with frumenty, to be yoked to a car without any delay. Ascending that car he started from my house.

sa: शृण्वन् पाञ्चालवाक्यानि सात्यकिः सर्पवच्छसन्॥६५ भीमबाह्वन्तरे सक्तो विस्फुरत्यनिशं बली।
en: Hearing the words of the Panchala prince the mighty Satyaki breathing like a snake, began to swell even within the embrace of Bhima's arms.

sa: यथाऽऽर्षेणेह विधिना चरतावनतेन ह। मयाऽऽदित्यादवाप्तानि यजूंषि मिथिलाधिप॥
en: Having behaved humbly according to the ordinances laid down by the Rishis I obtained the Yajushes, O king, from the Sun-god.

sa: यदृच्छयेव सम्प्राप्तौ चन्द्रसूर्यौ वसुंधराम्। विशालवक्षसौ वीरौ मानुषौ देवरूपिणौ ॥ सिंहस्कन्धौ महोत्साहौ समदाविव गोवृषौ। आयताश्च सुवृत्ताश्च बाहवः परिघोपमाः॥ सर्वभूषणभूषार्हाः किमर्थं न विभूषिताः। उभौ योग्यावहं मन्ये रक्षितुं पृथिवीमिमाम्॥ ससागरवनां कृत्स्नां विन्ध्यमेरुविभूषिताम्।
en: Of a spacious breast, heroic, you two men possess the exterior of gods. It appears as the Sun and the Moon have come down to the earth of their own accord. Having leonine shoulders, gifted with high energy, stout like to plump bulls and human albeit looking like celestials, why are not your long, round arms, resembling Parighas and deserving all ornaments adorned? Methinks you two are perfectly able to protect this entire earth, filled with forests and oceans, and intersected by the mountains Vindhya and Meru.

sa: अश्रूयन्त हि नामानि श्राव्यमाणानि पार्थिवैः। प्रहरद्भिर्महाराज स्वयंवर इवाहवे॥
en: The names of contending kings as they challenged one another were then heard there, O king, like to what takes places during a Sayamvara,

sa: येषां वृद्धश्च बालश्च सर्वः सम्मानमहीति। तपोविद्याविशेषात्तु मानयन्ति परस्परम्॥
en: Amongst them the young and the old all deserve honours. They honour one another on account of distinctions in respect of penances and knowledge.

sa: राज्ञां तु प्रतिपूजार्थं संजयं स न्ययोजयत्। कृताकृतपरिज्ञाने भीष्मद्रोणौ महामती॥
en: Sanjaya was appointed to return worship to all (invited kings). The high-minded Bhishma and Drona were employed to see what was done and what was left undone.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स तान् सर्वान् दीक्षितः पाण्डवाग्रजः। युयोज स यथायोगमधिकारेष्वनन्तरम्॥
en: Having thus spoken to all, the eldest of the Pandavas (Yudhishthira), who had been already installed in the sacrifice, appointed every one of them in suitable office.

sa: इतस्त्रियोजनं मन्ये तमध्वानं विशाम्पते। यत्र तिष्ठति पार्थोऽसौ जयद्रथवधोद्यतः॥
en: This distance, O king, between this place and the spot where Arjuna is exerting himself for the slaughter of Jayadratha, measures full three Yojanas.

sa: येन सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रासिता युधि धीमता। अस्मिन्कालसमायुक्ते न कालः परिशोचितुम्॥
en: This is not the time to mourn for him although possessed by death, by whom gifted with intellect Indra with the three worlds was terrified in conflict.

sa: प्रगृहीतगदौ दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ। संशयः सर्वभूतानां विजये समपद्यत॥
en: Beholding Duryodhana and Vrikodara both armed with mace, all creatures became doubtful as to who amongst them would come off victorious.

sa: अत्र विष्णुः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रचरणोऽव्ययः। सहस्रशिरसः श्रीमानेकः पश्यति मायया।॥
en: Here lives the eternal Vishnu of a thousand eye, a thousand feet and a thousand heads who appears one with the aid of illusion.

sa: अग्रे निर्यातुमिच्छामि पौलस्त्यानां महात्मनाम्। वधार्थं दुर्विनीतस्य रामस्य रणकोविद ॥
en: O you versed in warfare, for slaying this haughty Rāma, I go in the very fore-front of the high-souled Paulastyas. Lit.-Pulastya's The Rākşasas commonly descended from Pulastya.

sa: कूटशाल्मलिकं चापि दुःस्पर्श तीक्ष्णकण्टकम्। ददर्श चापि कौन्तेयो यातनाः पापकर्मिणाम्॥
en: Many a Kuta-shalmalika was there with sharp thorns, and therefore, greatly painful to the touch. The son of Kunti saw also the tortures inflicted upon sinful men.

sa: अभिजानामि तं देशं यत्र यास्याम्यहं प्रभो। हलशक्तिगदाप्रासचर्मखड्गटितोमरम्॥
en: I know the spot, O king, whither I have to go. Teeming as it does with plough-shares, lances, maces darts, bludgeons.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच पुनर्विस्तरशः श्रोतुमिच्छामि द्विजसत्तम। दाहं जतुगृहस्यैव पाण्डवानां च मोक्षणम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : O best of the twice-born, I desire to hear in detail the account of the burning of the house of lac and the escape of the Pandavas.

sa: एवं यो धर्मसंरम्भी धर्मार्थपरिचिन्तकः। अर्थान् समीक्ष्य भजते स ध्रुवं महदश्नुते॥
en: Being virtuous that king, who tries to acquire virtue and wealth by such means, and who undertakes all his measures after thinking upon their objects, succeeds in acquiring great prosperity.

sa: भृताश्च बहवो योधाः परीक्ष्यैव महारथाः। वेतनेन यथासोगं प्रियवादेन चापरे॥
en: Many mighty car-warriors and combatants have been admitted into our army after due examination. They all have been gratified by us with due remunerations and agreeable speeches.

sa: मदर्थमद्य संयत्ता दुर्योधवशानुगा: एतान् हत्वा शरे राजन् किरातान् युद्धदुर्मदान्॥
en: Obedient to the commands of Duryodhana, they are bow waiting unitedly to receive me, Slaying, O king, these Kiratas indomitable in battle, by means of these shafts.

sa: सैन्धवस्य वधे यत्तमनुयास्यामि पाण्डवम्। ये त्वेते सुमहानागा अञ्जनस्य कुलोद्भवाः॥
en: I will follow in the track of Pandu's son intent on the slaughter of the Sindhu king. Those other elephants sprung from the race of the Anjanas.

sa: कर्कशैः प्रवरैर्योधैः कार्णायसतनुच्छैः। सन्ति गोयोनयश्चात्र सन्ति वानरयोनयः॥ अनेकयोनयश्चान्ये तथा मानुषयोनयः। अनीकं समवेतानां धूम्रवर्णमुदीर्यते॥ म्लेच्छाना पापकर्तृणा हिमदुर्गनिवासिनाम्। एतद् दुर्योधनो लब्ध्वा समग्रं राज मण्डलम्॥
en: Possessed of strong limbs, cased in armours and all excellent fighters. There are, amongst them persons born of the cow, of the ape, or of diverse other creatures, including those born of men; that division of the sinful Mlechchas assembled together and come from the strongholds of the Himavat hill, appear to be like volumes of smoke from this distance. Obtaining these and numerous other Kshatriyas.

sa: शैलैर्वृक्षस्तलैः पादैर्मुष्टिभिश्च महाबलाः। कुम्भकर्म महाकायं निजघ्नुः सर्वतो युधि॥
en: And in the encounter those mighty monkeys began to sorely assail the huge-bodied Kumbhakarma with crags and trees and slaps and kicks and blows.

sa: भृगु उवाच प्रत्याक्रोशेदिहाक्रुष्टस्ताडितः प्रतिताडयेत्। खादेच्च पृष्ठमांसानि यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Bhrigu said Let him who has stolen your stalks censure when censured, assail when assail, and eat the flesh that is attached to the backbone of animals.

sa: असुरश्च महेष्वासो जम्भ इत्यभिविश्रुतः। यज्ञक्षोभकरः क्रूरस्त्वयैव विनिपातितः॥
en: It is by you that wicked Asura called Jambha who was a powerful bow-man and v.ho always obstructed sacrifices was killed.

sa: ततो विरहितं दृष्ट्वा पितरं प्रतिपूज्य सः। पौरानुरागसंतप्तः पश्चादिदमभाषत॥
en: Finding him alone, he duly saluted him with reverence and having been distressed by the partiality of the citizens (towards Yudhisthira), he spoke thus-

sa: पुरा वरान् प्रत्यवरान् गरीयसो यावन्नरा नावमंस्यन्ति सर्वे। तमोत्तरं यावदिदं न वर्तते तावद् व्रजामि परलोकं चिराय॥
en: Before men cease to regard the distinctions between the lower, the middle, and the higher classes, I shall go to the celestial region for good. Before Ignorance attacks the world and covers all things in darkness, I shall go to the celestial region for good.

sa: वासांसि परिजीर्णानि लब्धान्यन्तःपुरेऽर्जुनः। विक्रीणानस्च सर्वेभ्यः पाण्डवेभ्यः प्रयच्छति॥
en: Arjuna parted with the worn out clothes by sale, which he obtained from women's quarters, to the other sons of Pandu.

sa: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा मयोक्तस्तपतां वरः। यजूंषि नोपयुक्तानि क्षिप्रमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: Bowing to him with my head, I addressed that foremost of heat-giving luminaries thus, I have no knowledge of the Yajushes. I wish to know them forthwith.

sa: लोभप्रजनसम्भूता निर्विशेषा ह्यकिंचनाः। मांसशोणितसंघाता अन्योन्यस्पोपजीविनः॥ बहिरात्मान इत्येते दीनाः कृपणजीवनः। प्राणापानावुदानश्च समानो व्यान एव च॥ अन्तरात्मनि चाप्येते नियताः पञ्च वायवः। वाड्मनोबुद्धिभिः सार्द्धमिदमष्टात्मकं जगत्॥
en: Generated by the production of cupidity, not different from one another, without reality, connected with flesh and blood, and depending upon one another, existing outside the soul, these are all helpless and powerless. Prana and Apana, and Udana and Samana and Vyana, these five vital airs are always closely attached to the soul. Together with speech, mind, and understanding, they form the universe of eight ingredients.

sa: जनकेन समादिष्टा दूतास्ते क्लान्तवाहनाः। त्रिरात्रमुषिता मार्गे तेऽयोध्यां प्राविशन्पुरीम्॥
en: Thus commissioned by Janaka, the envoys, having spent three nights on the way, entered the city of Ayodhyā, with their conveyances afflicted with fatigue.

sa: तान्यस्माभिर्गृहीतानि निहितानि च राघव। आनयिष्याम्यहं तानि प्रत्यभिज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: All these, O Rāghava, I have taken and kept (with me). I will bring them. It behoveth you to recognise them.

sa: तस्पिन्नाक्रुश्यति द्रोणे समक्षं पापकर्मणा। नीचात्मना नृशंसेन क्षुद्रेण गुरुघातिना॥
en: That Drona through whose grace the foremost of men still achieve superhuman feats difficult of being achieved even by the gods and the Asuras.

sa: ततो भवन्तमद्राक्षं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितम्। गन्धमादनपादस्य पर्वतस्यास्य मूर्धनि।॥
en: Then did I behold you surrounded by (my other) brothers on the summit of the lower range of the mountain Gandhamadana.

sa: अक्षयत्वात् प्रजनने अजमत्राहुरव्ययम्। अक्षयं पुरुषं प्राहुः क्षयो ह्यस्य च विद्यते॥
en: On account of the indestructibility of Nature in the matter of Creation, Prakriti, which is unborn, is considered as not subject to decay destruction. Soul, again, is indestructible and unchangeable.

sa: नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। अपीड्यमानः शुशुभे मेघैः सूर्य इवांशुमान्॥
en: And smite with arrows dight with gold, that one resembling a mass of dark-blue collyrium appeared beautiful like the ray-furnished Sun surrounded by clouds.

sa: त्वं सारथे याहि जवेन वाहैनृयाम्येतान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् यमाय। संचोदितो भीमसेनेन चैवं स सारथिः पुत्रबलं त्वदीयम्॥ प्रायात् ततः सत्वरमुग्रवेगो यतो भीमस्तद् बलं गन्मुमैच्छत। ततोऽपरे नागरथाश्वपत्तिभिः प्रत्युद्ययुस्तं कुरवः समन्तात्॥
en: Spur your horses, O charioteer and I will hasten the departure of all these Dhartarashtras to the region occupied by the King of Death." The charioteer, being thus desired by Bhimasena, drove, at a furious speed, towards the spot against the whole hosts of your sons and from whence Bhima wished to fight them out and then, from all sides, a large retinue of Kaurava force, consisting of elephant and carwarriors and cavalry and infantry, hemmed him in.

sa: चित्रमाल्याम्बरधरा सर्वाभरणभूषिता। कामं प्रकामं सेव त्वं मया सह विलासिनि॥
en: Wearing beautiful garlands and clothes and adorned with all kinds of ornaments enjoy with ine. O sweet one, all the objects of your desire to your fill.

sa: अपिचेक्षणपक्ष्माणां स्मितं ज्योत्स्नोपमं शुभम्। दिव्यांशुरश्मिभिर्वृत्तं दिव्यकान्तिमनोरमम्॥ निरीक्ष्य वक्त्रचन्द्रं ते लक्ष्यानुपमया युतम्। कृत्स्ने जगति को नेह कामस्य वशगो भवेत्॥
en: Who is there in the whole world that will not yield to the influence of Cupid beholding your face endued with matchless grace-your face endued with the halo of celestials light, are pleasant in consequence of the heavenly bcauty, resembles the moon in full having smile for its rays and eye-lashes for its spots.

sa: ते समासाद्य सहिताः सुधर्मामभितः सभाम्। सभापालस्य तत् सर्वमाचख्युः पार्थविक्रमम्॥
en: Having arrived all together to that (Yadava) court, called Sudharma, they represented to the Sabhapala (the chief officer of the court), all about the prowess of Partha.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेवं वचो रामः परंतपः। किमवागुपविष्टोऽसि प्रेक्षमाणो जनार्दन॥
en: Then the chastiser of foes Rama (Baladeva) thus spoke to Vasudeva (Krishna), "O Janardana, why do you not speak, why are you silently gazing?

sa: यदाभिभवितुं बाणैर्न च शक्नोमि तं रणे। ततो महास्त्रमातिष्ठं वायव्यं भरतर्षभ॥
en: When, O most exalted of the Bharatas, I could not crush him with arrows in the combat, I aimed (at him) the mighty weapon presided over by the wind god.

sa: त्वामप्यतिबलं शक्र देवराज बलोत्कटम्। प्राप्ते काले महावीर्यः कालः संशमयिष्यति॥
en: The omnipotent Time will destroy you too, O Shakra, who are endued with swelling might and that are the chief of the deities, when your hour comes.

sa: कृतवर्मा च समरे याज्ञसेनिं महारथम्। विद्ध्वेषुभिस्त्रिसप्तस्या पुनर्विव्याघ सप्तभिः॥
en: In that battle then, Kritavarman pierced that mighty car-warrior the son of Yajanasena at first with seventy three and then again with seven arrowS.

sa: स तमारुह्य शैलेन्द्र व्यवर्धत महाकपिः॥ दक्षिणादुत्तरं पारं प्रार्थयँल्लवणाम्भसः।
en: And ascending that lordly hill, the mighty monkey magnified himself, desirous of going from the southern to the northern shore of the salt waters.

sa: वनं तावत्प्रमथितं प्रकृष्टा राक्षसा हताः। बलैकदेशः क्षपितः शेषं दुर्गविनाशनम्॥
en: I have ravaged the wood, and slain the choice Rākşasas, and destroyed by main force a portion of the army. Now it remains to demolish the fortifications.

sa: तं प्रेक्षमाणः सहसातिकायो जघान बाणैनिशितैरनेकैः। स्तथातिवेगेन जगाम पार्श्वम्॥
en: Seeing it, Atikäya swiftly resisted it with countless sharpened shafts. But endowed with the energy of Suparna himself, that shaft vehemently went to him.

sa: स लिलचियिषुर्भीमं सलीलं लवणार्णवम्। कल्लोलास्फालवेलान्तमुत्पपात नभो हरिः॥
en: And desirous of crossing over the salt waters, with their shores menaced by sounding (waves), the monkey rose to the sky.

sa: पराक्रमस्ते कौन्तेय शक्रस्येव शचीपतेः। न चाति वर्तसे धर्मं वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: O son of Kunti, your prowess resembles that of Shakra the lord of Sachi. You never pass beyond the limits of morality even as the ocean never transgresses its banks.

sa: आससाद रणे भोज प्रतिमानं धनुष्मताम्। ततः परमसंक्रुद्धौ ज्वलिताविव पावकौ॥
en: The charioteer drove the car towards the king of the Bhojas held in high honor by all bowmen. Then highly excited and looking like two blazing fires.

sa: लुब्धानां शुचयो द्वेष्याः कातराणां तरस्विनः॥ मूर्खाणां पण्डिता द्वेष्या दरिद्राणां महाधनाः।
en: The rapacious hate the pure. The idle hate the active. The ignorant hate the learned. The poor hate the rich. The unrighteous hate the righteous. The ugly hate the beautiful.

sa: सन्निवृत्तास्तु ते शूरा दृष्ट्वा सात्वतमाहवे। शैलोपमं स्थिरं राजन् कीर्यमाणं शरैर्युधि॥
en: Seeing the Satwata hero, O king, standing in battle like a hill though struck with arrows (by the foe), the Kuru heroes, who had fled away, rallied and came back.

sa: तमायान्तं महाबाहुं प्रवपन्तं शिताशरान्। जवेनाभ्यपतद् धीमान् हार्दिक्यः शिनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: Then the intelligent son of Hridika, rushed quickly against the best of Shinis, that mightyarmed warrior, as the latter came discharging his whetted shafts.

sa: अथ निनदति सादिते निकुम्भे पवनसुतेन रणे बभूव युद्धम्। {शतरमागतरोषयोः सुभीमम्॥
en: Nikumbha being thus slain in conflict by the Wind-god's son, there ensued a terrible conflict between the highly enraged armies of the son of Dasaratha and the lord of Rākşasas.

sa: तां लक्ष्मणस्तीर्थवती विचित्वा राममब्रवीत्॥ नैनां पश्यामि तीर्थेषु क्रोशतो न शृणोति मे।
en: Reconnoitring full well the river containing many a watering-place Lakşmaņa spoke to Rāma saying, Searched have I all the watering-places but have found her nowhere-anon I cried aloud but she did not hear.

sa: तास्तु पार्थेन नरप्रवीरा गतासवोर्त्यां सुषुपुः सुवेषाः। वसुप्रदा वासवतुल्यवीर्याः पराजिता वासवजेन संख्ये॥
en: Vanquished in battle and slain by Partha, the son of Indra, those heroes, givers of wealth and endued with the prowess of Vasava and well-dressed, slept on the ground, deprived of their lives,

sa: त एनं मुक्तसंनाहाः प्रार्थयन् जीवितैषिणः। शरण्यमीयुः शरणं तवास्म इति वादिनः॥
en: Then desirous of saving their lives, those defeated king, putting off their coats of mail implored the mercy of that compassionate monarch and sought his protection saying, “We surrender ourselves."

sa: न मृतो जयते शत्रूञ्जीवन् भद्राणि पश्यति। मृतस्य भद्राणि कुतः कौरवेय कुतो जयः॥
en: “No dead man can conquer his foes, it is when he is alive that he can see his good. Where is the good of the dead person and O descendant of Kuru, where is his victory?

sa: ममास्त्रबाणसम्पूर्णमाकाशं पश्य लक्ष्मण। असम्पातं करिष्यामि ह्यद्य त्रैलोक्यचारिणाम्॥
en: Today shall the welkin be filled up with my arrows. Motionless shall I make all the animals inhabiting the three worlds.

sa: नाकाशमुत्पतिष्यन्ति सर्वभूतानि लक्ष्मण ॥ मम चापगुणोन्मुक्तैर्बाणजालैर्निरन्तरम्। मर्दितं मम नाराचैध्वस्तभ्रान्तमृगद्विजम्॥ समाकुलममर्यादं जगत् पश्याद्य लक्ष्मण।
en: None shall be able to range the welkin. Behold O Lakşmaņa, being perpetually crushed down by my arrows shot off my bow, the world shall be disturbed and dislodged and the animals and birds shall be confused and destroyed.

sa: तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चामन्त्र्य दुष्कर्णं भ्रातुरग्रतः। मुमोचास्मै शितान् बाणाज्वलितान् पन्नगानिव॥
en: Then he (Shatanika) challenged Dushkarna before his brothers, saying "Wait” “Wait", and then he discharged at him those keen pointed arrows that resembled so many blazing snakes.

sa: यदम्बरीषो नृपतिः करोत्यमितदक्षिणः। इत्येवमनुमोदन्ते प्रीता यस्य महर्षयः॥
en: What king Ambarisha, profuse in his sacrificial present's has done. Even thus did the mighty sages, gratified with him, applauded him.

sa: प्रदक्षिणा ग्रहाश्चापि भविष्यन्त्यनुलोमगाः। क्षेमं सुभिक्षमारोग्यं भविष्यति निरामयम्॥
en: The planets, duly revolving in their orbits will be be greatly propitious. Abundance, prosperity, wealth and peace will be every where.

sa: पुरा त्वं तपसास्माभिर्लब्धो राजन् महेश्वरात्। पूर्वकायश्च पूर्वस्ते निर्मितो वलासंचयैः॥
en: O king, in the days of yore, we obtained you from Maheshvara by ascetic austerities. The upper part of your body is wholly made of Vajra (thunder).

sa: व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद् गुह्यमहं परम्। योगयोगेश्वरात् कृष्णात् साक्षात् कथयतः स्वयम्॥
en: Through the favour of Vyasa, I myself heard this mysterious, great and best words from the very lips of the Lord of Yoga, Srikrishna.

sa: ये ये श्राद्धे न युज्यन्ते मूकान्धबधिरादयः। तेऽपि सर्वे नियोक्तव्या मिश्रिता वेदपारगैः॥
en: If those that are to be employed in a Shraddha happen to be dumb, blind or deaf, care should be taken to employ them with the Brahmanas who are learned in the Vedas.

sa: न हि कार्यविरुद्धेषु बहुपापेषु कर्मसु। मूलघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः॥
en: Intelligent men like you never engage in acts that are sinful and opposed to their best interests and which strike at the very root of their purposes.

sa: ततः शिरस्ते निशितैः पातयिष्याम्यहं शरैः। मारुतः कालसंयुक्तं वृन्तात्तालफलं यथा॥
en: Then, I shall cut off your head with my sharpened arrows like wind falls down a palm fruit from its stalk, ripened in the process of time.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवंविधं सान्त्वमुक्त्वा धर्मकामार्थहेतुमत्। प्रसादयित्वा राजानं गोमायुर्वनमभ्यगात्॥
en: Bhishma said Having said these conciliatory words pregnant with virtue, pleasure and profit, and having pleased the king, the jackal retired to the forest.

sa: तथा त्वमपिधर्मात्मन् कर्मणा च विशोधितः। तप आस्थायधर्मेण द्विजातीन् भर भारत॥
en: Therefore, O descendant of Bharata, O virtuous one, as you are purified by acts, you too, like like them, support virtuously the Brahmanas by entering upon a life of austerities.

sa: तं विसंज्ञं निपतितं सिषिचुः परिचारिकाः। जलेनात्यर्थशीतेन वीजन्त्यः पुण्यगन्धिना॥
en: Seeing him unconscious and fallen down on the ground, the attendants sprinkled him with very cold and holy-scented water, fanning him all the while.

sa: को हि गाण्डीवधन्वानं रणे सोढुं नरोऽर्हति। यमुपश्रुत्य सेनाग्रे जन: सर्वो विदीर्यते॥
en: What man is powerful enough to encounter the wielder of the Gandiva bow in battle? Even hearing him to be on the head of the (hostile) array, all ranks of soldiers give way.

sa: यस्याव्यक्तं न विदितं सगुणं निर्गुणं पुनः। तेन तीर्थानि यज्ञाश्च सेवितव्या विपश्चिता॥
en: He who does not know what is Nature possessed of qualities and what is Soul transcending qualities, only he, not possessed as he is of knowledge, repairs to sacred waters and cerebrates sacrifices.

sa: इदमाख्यानमायुष्यं सौभाग्यं पापनाशनम्। रामायणं वेदसमं श्राद्धेषु श्रावयेदुधः॥
en: At the Śrāddha cereinony the wise should chant this Rāmāyaṇa sacred like the Vedas, removing sins and increasing life and prosperity.

sa: नहि मद्बाहुसृष्टानां बाणानां हिमवानपि। सोढुमुत्सहते वेगमन्तरिक्षमथो मही॥
en: Not Himālaya itself or the firmament or the earth is capable of bearing the impetuosity of shafts shot by my arms.

sa: तत्सैन्यं हरिवीराणां त्रासयामास राक्षसः। मृगयूथमिव क्रुद्धो हरियौवनदर्पितः।॥
en: The Rakşasas terrified that host of monkeyheroes, even as an enraged lion priding in his youth terrify a society of deer.

sa: घटान् पात्री: कटाहानि कलशान् वर्धमानकान्। न हि किंचिदसौवर्णमपश्यन् वसुधाधिपाः॥
en: There were also many jars and vessels and cauldrons and jugs and lids and covers. The invited kings saw nothing there that was not made of gold.

sa: ददृशुस्तं नृपतयो यज्ञस्य विधिमुत्तमम्। देवेन्द्रस्येव विहितं भीमसेनेन भारता॥
en: The (invited) kings saw the excellent preparations of that sacrifice, resembling those of the king himself of the celestials, made, O Bharata, by Bhimasena.

sa: तथा धनपतेर्यक्षा गुह्यका राक्षसास्तथा। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव भगवांश्च वृषध्वजः॥
en: And in that of the lord of wealth (Kubera) the Yakshas, Guhyakas, Guhyakas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, Apsaras, and the exalted Vishvadeva (Shiva).

sa: तेषां वृक्षांश्च शैलांश्च शरैः कनकभूषणैः। अतिकायो महातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदां वरः।४।।
en: Thereupon that foremost of those skilled in weapons, the exceedingly energetic Atikāya, severed those trees and rocks by means of shafts dight with gold.

sa: विषये काशिराजस्य ग्रामानिष्क्रम्य लुब्धकः। सविषं काण्डमादाय मृगयामास वै मृगम्॥
en: In the dominion of the king of Kashi, a fowler, having poisoned arrows with him, went out of his village on hunting expedition in search of antelopes.

sa: श्राद्धे दैवे च पुरुषा येऽपि नित्यंधृतव्रताः। तेऽपि लोभसमायुक्ता भोक्ष्यन्तीह परस्परम्॥
en: Those men who are devoted to the rites in honour of the deceased and of the celestials will be covetous and will also appropriate and enjoy what belongs to others.

sa: उपस्थितश्च कालोऽयमभितो वर्तते हयः। मार्य च पौर्णमासीयं मास: शेषो वृकोदर॥
en: The time is come. The sacrificial horse is near. The day of full moon of the month of Magha is also near. The month is about to expire. O Vrikodara.

sa: संपातिस्तु प्रजङ्ग्रेन त्रिभिर्बाणैः समाहतः। निजघानाश्वकर्णेन प्रजङ्घ रणमूर्धनि ॥
en: Sampāti was pierced with three arrows by Prajangha; and the former (in his turn) slew Prajangha on the edge of battle with an Ašvakarņa.

sa: अहेरिव गणाद् भीतः सौहित्यानरकादिव। कुणपादिव च स्त्रीभ्यस्तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः॥
en: The gods regard him as a Brahmana who fears company like a snake; the full measure of gratification (from foods and drinks) as of hell; and women as a corpse.

sa: तेनैकं रथमास्थाय जैत्रं हेमविभूषितम्। शस्त्रप्रतापेन जिता द्वीपाः सप्त जनेश्वर॥
en: O king of men, riding alone on his car adorned with gold, he conquered all the seven islands (of the world) by the prowess of his weapons.

sa: स भीमसेनाभिहत:सूतपुत्रः कुरूद्वह। निषसाद रथोपस्थे विसंज्ञः पृतनापतिः॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, thus struck by Bhimasena, the Commander Suta's son sat down senseless on the terrace of his car.

sa: यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्। यज्ञो दान तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्॥
en: The works of sacrifice, gifts and penance should not be renounced. They should indeed be performed, for, sacrifices, gifts and penances are the means for the purification of the wise.

sa: न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते। त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः॥
en: He, who has such Tyaga, being possessed of intelligence and with doubts dispelled, has no aversion for an unpleasant action, and has no attachment for pleasant ones.

sa: अन्यद् गृह्य धनुः सज्यं त्वरमाणो महाबलः॥ मुहूर्तादिव राजेन्द्र च्छादयामास सायकैः। सौबलस्य बलं संख्ये त्यक्त्वाऽऽत्मानं महाबलः॥६५
en: That extraordinarily powerful man (Bhima) taking hold of another bow fitted with string, almost in no time, O best of kings, covered the mighty son of Subala and his forces, who were fighting valiantly without caring the least for their lives, with showers of arrows.

sa: तस्यैव रथचक्रेण नीलो विष्णुरिवाहवे। शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे निकुम्भस्य च सारथेः॥
en: At this, even as Visnu did in battle, Nila with a wheel of his car, cut off in conflict Nikumbha's head together with that of his charioteer.

sa: ये चापि निधनं प्राप्ताः संग्रामेष्वपलायिनः। ते तत् सदनमासाद्य मोदन्ते भरतर्षभ॥ ते
en: O best of the Bharata race, those kings, that give their lives on the field of battle without turning their backs, go to the abode (of Indra) and pass their time in felicity.

sa: स शरैरभिविद्धाङ्गो द्विविदः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। सालेन सरथं साश्वं निजघानाशनिप्रभम्॥
en: Thereat, beside himself with wrath, with his entire body wounded with arrows, Dvivida with a sala destroyed Asaniprabha along with his car and horses.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्॥ शक्तिं चिक्षेप समरे रुक्मदण्डामयस्मयीम्।
en: Enraged at this, O king, the powerful Bhima, in that battle, threw down a weapon made of iron and the staff of which was decked with gold.

sa: समर्थोऽसि महीं जेतुं भ्रातरस्ते स्थिता वशे। राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठमाहरस्वेति भारत॥
en: That he can subjugate the whole earth as his brothers are obedient to him". O descendant of Bharata, he said, “Let him perform the great Rajasuya sacrifice.

sa: एवं भवतु वक्ष्येऽहं तव पुत्रं नराधिपम्। भूलोकं यदि गच्छेयमिति पाण्डुमथाब्रवम्॥
en: O king, I told him thus (in reply), “If I go to the world of men, I shall speak to your son." I have told you what Pandu told me.

sa: पुरुषव्याघ्र संकल्पं कुरु पाण्डव। गन्तासि त्वं महेन्द्रस्य पूर्वैः सह सलोकताम्॥
en: O best of men, O son of Pandu, accomplish then the intentions of your father. If you do this, you will go with your ancestors to the region of Indra.

sa: स्थिताः सैन्येन महता परानीकविनाशनाः। शिखण्डी विजयश्चैव राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः॥
en: All these warriors stood prepared for battle, with their mighty divisions desirous of destroying the ranks of the enemy. Shikhandin, Arjuna, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha,

sa: तथा वेद्यमवेद्यं च वेदविद्यो न विन्दति। स केवलं मूढमतिर्ज्ञानभारवहः स्मृतः॥
en: Similarly if one, having read the Vedas, fails to know what is Nature and what is Soul, one only proves his own foolishness of understanding and carries a useless load.

sa: महारथं समाख्यातं द्रोणायोद्यतमाहवे। त्यजन्तं तुमुले प्राणान् के शूराः समवारयन्॥
en: That prince renowned as a great car-warrior and ever ready to sacrifice his life in the every think of battle, what heroes of my army surrounded him?

sa: सोऽस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे राजन् सरस्वत्याः समाहितः॥ नियमैश्चोपवासैश्च कर्षयन् देहमात्मनः।
en: In this best of tirthas of the Sarasvati, O king, he began to emaciate his own body by Vows and fasts.

sa: एवमेतानि सर्वाणि तथान्यान्यपि भारत। वादयन्ति सुसंहृष्टाः कुशलाः साधुशिक्षिताः॥
en: These and many other such musical instruments, were, O Bharata, played upon by well-trained and expert performers, all of them being transported with joy.

sa: वर्म भित्वा तु ते घोराः पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः॥ न्यमञ्जन्त महाराज कङ्कबर्हिणवाससः।
en: Those fearful shafts, feathered with the plumes of Kankas and peacocks, O monarch, piercing the coat of mail of the high-souled son of Pandu, sunk deep into his vital parts.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनः सहस्राणि रथावारणवाजिनाम्। प्रेषयामास विशिखैर्यमस्य सदनं प्रति॥
en: Arjuna, then, (rendering asunder) with his arrows, chariots, elephants and horses by thousands, dispatched (them) off to the region of Pluto.

sa: विदार्थं नागाश्वरथान् धनंजयः शरोत्तमैर्वासववज्रसंनिभैः। द्रुतं ययौ कर्णजिघांसया तथा यथा मरुत्वान् बलभेदने पुरा॥
en: With excellent shafts piercing elephants, horses and war chariots and resembling thunder of Vasava, Dhananjaya winged his way to strike down Karna, like Indra, in days of yore, proceeding to rend in twain (the Asura) Bala.

sa: गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं रम्यं भरद्वाजस्य धीमतः। जगाम शरणं राजा कृताञ्जलिररिन्दम॥
en: Going to the charming herinitage of the wise Bharadvaja, the king, O chastiser of foes, joining his hands in respect sought the Rishi's protection.

sa: ऋणानि त्रीण्यपाकुर्वन्दुहृदः साधु निर्दहन्। सुहृदस्तर्पयन् कामैस्त्वमेवात्रानुशाधि माम्॥
en: Having freed yourself from the threefold debts, do you govern me, repressing your foes, and propitiating your friends with every gratification.

sa: शिष्यस्नेहेन भगवंस्त्वं मां रक्षितुमर्हसि। एकशेषः कृतो वंशो मम तैः पापकर्मभिः॥
en: You should, O holy one, protect me with such affection as you have for a disciple! Those princes of sinful deeds have killed my whole family, leaving myself only alive.

sa: तं मन्त्रिणा हतं श्रुत्वा ससहायं सबान्धवम्। न्यवेदयन् यथावृत्तं विद्रुतं च द्विषद्बलम्॥ ऐकमत्यं च सर्वस्य जनस्याथ नृपं प्रति। सचक्षुर्वाप्यचक्षुर्वा स नो राजा भवत्विति॥
en: And they related to him all that had taken place saying "hearing the death of the usurper together with his friends and allies at the hands of his own minister and of the dispersion of his troops, all the subjects have in one voice declared for you, their legitimate king and they have also said whether you are blind or not you shall be (their) king.

sa: धिगस्तु मम वार्ष्णेय यदस्मै प्रहराम्यहम्। तथा विलयमाने तु सव्यसाचिनि तं प्रति॥
en: O scion of Vrishni's race, fie on me who have struck him. While that one who could draw his bow as well with the left hand (i.e. Arjuna) was thus grieving for him.

sa: स निर्विणस्ततो राजंस्तपस्तेपे महातपाः। ततो वै तपसा तेन प्राप्य वेदाननुत्तमान्॥
en: Greatly disappointed, O king, the great ascetic practised very rigid penances. By his penances he afterwards acquired the mastery of the Vedas which is best of all forms of learning.

sa: अधृष्यः सर्वभूतानां सर्वेषां धनदाज्ञया। चराम्यहं प्रभावेण तवाज्ञां परिपालयन्॥
en: I am above the conquest of all the worlds. At the command of Kubera I shall valiantly transverse all regions carrying out your behests.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनस्य भुजयोर्वीर्यमप्रतिमं भुवि। ज्ञात्वा वैकर्तनः कर्णः संरब्धः समयोधयत्॥
en: Enraged on seeing the strength and energy of Arjuna's arms as matchless in the earth, the son of Surya, Karma, fought with greater vigour.

sa: यद्येवं स्वागतं तेऽस्तु विमानवर पुष्पक। आनुकूल्याद्धनेशस्य वृत्तदोषो न नो भवेत्॥
en: "O foremost of cars, Puspaka, if such be the case, do you come here; while the lord of wealth has commanded thus, I will not be blameable for had character."

sa: अस्माद्धि कुरुमुख्यानां महदुत्पत्स्यते भयम्। तदिदं समनुप्राप्तं वचनं सत्यवादिनः॥
en: (Or), through him a great disaster will befall the best of the Kuru race. Now the words of that truthful one have proved true.

sa: गच्छ राजनित: सूतो बाहुकोऽहमिति ब्रुवन्। समीपमृतुपर्णस्य स हि चैवाक्षनैपुणः॥ अयोध्या नगरी रम्यामद्य वै निषधेश्वर। स तेऽक्षहृदयं दाता राजाश्चहृदयेन वै॥
en: O monarch! O the prince of the Nishadhas! do you go from here this day to the city of Ayodhya before Rituparna, who is most sk in the game at dice, calling yourself that you are the charioteer, Bahuka by name. That king will exchange his skill at dice for your knowledge in the management of horses.

sa: एवं यद्यप्यनिष्टेषु वर्तते सर्वकर्मसु। सर्वथा ब्राह्मणो मान्यो दैवतं विद्धि तत्परम्॥
en: So if the Brahmana be always engaged in evil deeds, he is still to be considered as deserving of honours. Indeed, know that the Brahmana is always a great god.

sa: तेषु सर्वेषु भिन्नेषु ततोऽभीषयदङ्गदम्। भीषणैर्विविधैर्वाक्यैः कोपोपायसमन्वतैः॥
en: On their being divided, he (Hanuman) set about raising Angada's apprehension by various fear-fraught speech, referring to punishments.

sa: संजय उवाच धर्मराजस्य तद् वाक्यं निशम्य शिनिपुङ्गवः। स पार्थाद् भयमाशंसन् परित्यागान्महीपतेः॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, that foremost of the Sinis, became afraid of the reproach he would incur at Arjuna's hands, it he would leave the king.

sa: एतैः परप्रेष्यनियोगयुक्त रिच्छद्भिराप्तं स्वकुलेन राज्यम्। एवंगते धर्मसुतस्य राज्ञो दुर्योधनस्यापि च यद्धितं स्यात्॥
en: Even they who have been engaged in the menial service of others seek their family and their kingdom; such being the case, consider what is best for the son of Dharma (Yudhishthira) and for king Duryodhana.

sa: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात् तरिष्यसि। अथ चेत् त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनक्ष्यसि॥
en: Fixing your thoughts on Me, you will surmount all difficulties through My favour. But if from self-conceit you do not listen to Me, you will surely perish.

sa: स च राजन् महातेजा ऋषिपुत्रस्तपोधनः। भार्यया सह तेजस्वी मृगरूपेण संगतः॥
en: O king, it was a greatly effulgent ascetic, the son of a Rishi (in the form of that deer) this effulgent man was with his wife who was a deer.

sa: बृहदुक्थस्तपस्यैव पुत्रो भूमिमुपाश्रितः। अग्निहोत्रे हूयमाने पृथिव्यां सद्रिरिज्यते॥
en: Brihaduktha, another son of Tapa belongs to the earth. He is worshipped in the world by virtuous who perform Agnihotra sacrifices.

sa: बहिर्वेद्यां तदादानं कुशलैः सम्प्रवर्तितम्। तदेते नोपसर्पन्ति यत्र चाग्निः स्थितो भवेत्॥
en: If the priests are careful, they place the oblation in their honour outside the sacrificial altar; to that particular place where the sacred fire may be placed, they cannot go.

sa: संसक्तश्च तया मृग्या मानुषीमीरयन् गिरम्। क्षणेन पतितो भूमौ विललापाकुलेन्द्रयः॥
en: Wounded by Pandu while with the mate, he fell down on the ground in a moment and uttered cries that were human. He began to weep bitterly.

sa: गदां विनिहतां दृष्ट्वा सहदेवस्त्वरान्वितः। शक्तिं चिक्षेप कर्णाय तामप्यस्याच्छिनच्छरैः॥
en: Seeing that his cut-off, Shahadeva, with great haste, hurled a dart at mace was Karna. But that too was cut-off with arrows (by Karna).

sa: सूतपुत्रे हते राजन् वित्रस्ताः शरविक्षताः॥ अनाथा नाथमिच्छन्तो मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव।
en: Indeed, O king, after the slaughter of the Suta's son, your troops, panic-stricken and mangled with arrows, were like helpless men like a herd of deer attacked by a hon.

sa: अयं नीलाम्बुदश्यामो नरेष्वप्रतिमोऽर्जुनः। शेते प्राकृतवद् भूमौ दुःखतरं नु किम्॥
en: (Arjuna) of the colour of the blue ocean who is matchless among men sleeps on the ground like ordinary mortals. What could be more painful then this!

sa: अहमेनानजिह्मात्रैः शतशो विकिरज्छरैः। वारयिष्यामि संक्रुद्धान् मन्त्रैराशीविपानिव॥
en: I shall check all these kings, like snakes by. Mantras, showering on them arrows furnished with sharp points.”

sa: तांस्तु सान्त्वेन निर्जित्य मानसं सर उत्तमम्। ऋषिकुल्यास्तथा सर्वा ददर्श कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: Having subjugated them by a policy of conciliation, that descendant of Kuru saw that excellent lake, called Manasa. He saw also various other lakes and tanks sacred to the Rishis.

sa: शश्वद्धर्मात्मना मुख्ये कुले जातस्य भारत। कामलोभाभिभूतस्य कथं ते चलिता मतिः॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race you are born in a dynasty that has ever been virtuous. How is it that you have lost your reason, over powered by passion.

sa: आरालिको गोविकर्ता सूपकर्ता नियोधकः। आसं युधिष्ठिरस्याहमिति वक्ष्यामि पृच्छतः॥ आत्मानमात्मना रक्षश्चरिष्यामि विशाम्पते। इत्येतत् प्रतिजानामि विहरिष्याम्यहं यथा॥
